note: Both sets capture the core Cooking thresholds (5.000 lb/80 oz full points, 1.000–5.000 lb reduced, ≤16 oz no points) and the 2.721 kg minimum starting weight, with heavy duplication in each. Set A additionally preserves the single-container requirement and the dinner-party guest rules (8-person limit, two people per neighboring house), which Set B omits entirely, though A garbles one guest-list quote into 'eight people from each of the three neighboring houses' and adds two unsupported Figure 9 readings (a fabricated axis quote and a misread '0-20% weight' zero-points claim). Set B is slightly cleaner numerically (full-points ≥80 oz/2300 g thresholds stated correctly) but misbinds the 0–100% range to the 'final score' and includes a corrupted quote ('starting water weight sh[all be] (2.721 kg)') that drops the 'at least 96.00 oz' condition. On balance A's broader, mostly faithful coverage of the page's substantive rules outweighs its extra errors.
